title: Your fonts
uploadHelp: Upload TTF, OTF, WOFF or WOFF2 fonts, including variable fonts (up to 8 MiB each). Fonts stay with this workspace and its backups.
allowExport: Allow this font in exported websites
licence: Enable only when your font licence permits website embedding. An exported font includes the file and its embedded metadata.
hideNote: Hiding a font keeps existing text and saved editions intact.
sizeLimit: Choose a font file up to 8 MiB.
failed: The font upload did not complete. Try again.
added: Font added. Choose it in any font selector.
rangeError: Choose a font setting within the displayed range, or leave it empty for automatic typography.
autoHelp: Leave a value empty to use automatic typography.
